about.name: Hugo Dorne
about.title: Senior Software Engineer & Scrum Master
about.summary:
Full Stack and AI developments.
Main stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Spring AI, LangChain.
Project management: Scrum Master in SAFe environments, team supervision, estimation and pre-sales.

description: Backend engineer on the traveller information team, serving itinerary, timing and proximity information to mobile apps used in over half of the cities running a soft-mobility service
Scrum Master of a cross-functional team of five — two backend, iOS, Android and QA — coordinating with the other teams under SAFe
Build the backend-for-frontend exposing itineraries and travel information to the mobile clients
Maintain the real-time stack: WebSocket subscriptions delivering live updates on the trips each client follows
Refactored the Livemap module end to end, the real-time map subscription layer
Ran version upgrades across all of the team's applications
Built AI agents and tools with LangChain4J and Spring AI, exposed over MCP
Generated Gherkin / Cucumber test cases from user stories
Took part in the estimation and pre-sales of a €400k application
Supervised a team of 6 software engineers, part of the team based in India
Led the backend as Tech Lead on an application redesign, on a hexagonal architecture with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Nx and Angular 18
Defined the new application's requirements, architecture and processes with the client
Estimated the TWINS scope at over €100k and around 100 man-days
Digitised the prison administration's processes, rolled out nationwide across French prisons
Scrum Master within an agile release train, on teams of two frontend and three backend engineers, a business analyst and a shared project manager
Built and shipped features on the Spring Boot / Angular stack
Mentored software engineering interns and apprentices
Developed, tested, debugged and maintained web applications in Java, Angular and React

education.details: Startup Weekend Nantes 2021 winner with the project Q'lture
